comparison.objective: Measure a burger patty's internal temperature by probing through its side to the centre.
comparison.physical_skill: Stabilize a compliant food item with a turner while inserting a slender probe at controlled height, angle, and depth.
comparison.success_condition: Valid centre reading without breakout or excessive patty motion, followed by withdrawal, tool placement, release, and stillness.
comparison.reason: Bimanual stabilization and probing are different from shared-load screen manipulation and selective many-body recovery. No material rubric details are missing.
